details_text: The National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology (NIELIT), Calicut, in collaboration with Object Automation System Solutions Pvt. Ltd., presents an 8-week online MOOC on Open-Source Processor Architecture (IBM OpenPOWER) and SoC Design.This programme introduces participants to processor architecture, Verilog RTL design, open-source EDA tools and System-on-Chip (SoC) development through structured learning and practical activities.The course provides 120 learning hours, self-paced LMS access with 24×7 availability, expert-led sessions and hands-on laboratory experience.Start Date: 18 January 2027Duration: 8 WeeksMode: OnlineCertification Charges: ₹1,200Interested candidates must register through the official NIELIT registration portal.

title: Online Internship on Chip Design Using Synopsys® EDA Tools 2026
organiser: National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology (NIELIT) Calicut
description: Online Internship on Chip Design Using Synopsys® EDA ToolsOrganised by: National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology (NIELIT), CalicutMinistry of Electronics & Information Technology, Government of…
details_text: Online Internship on Chip Design Using Synopsys® EDA ToolsOrganised by: National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology (NIELIT), CalicutMinistry of Electronics & Information Technology, Government of IndiaAbout the ProgrammeThe Online Internship on Chip Design Using Synopsys® EDA Tools is a four-week technical training programme designed to introduce participants to the complete ASIC design flow, from RTL development to the final GDSII layout database.The programme consists of two weeks of structured training followed by two weeks of remote laboratory support. Participants will gain practical exposure to digital design using Verilog HDL, functional simulation, code coverage, logic synthesis, physical design, static timing analysis and physical verification.The training begins with digital design and synthesis using Xilinx Vivado and progresses to industry-standard Synopsys® EDA tools for ASIC implementation.Programme HighlightsFour-week structured online internship.Two weeks of technical training.Two weeks of remote laboratory support.Self-paced, pre-recorded learning materials available 24×7 through LMS.Hands-on experience with Synopsys® EDA tools.Practical exposure to RTL-to-GDSII design flow.Independent mini-project during the laboratory phase.Certificate upon successful completion.Technical TopicsIntroduction to RTL-to-GDSII Design FlowDigital Logic Design using Verilog HDL in VivadoDigital Logic Synthesis using VivadoSimulation using VCS®Coverage using VCS®Logic Synthesis using Design Compiler®Floorplanning and Power Planning using IC Compiler II™Placement and Clock Tree Synthesis using IC Compiler II™Routing and Sign-off using IC Compiler II™Static Timing Analysis using PrimeTime®Physical Verification using IC Validator™EligibilityB.Tech students (all branches), including ongoing and passed-out studentsM.Tech studentsFaculty membersIndustry professionalsResearch scholarsNo prior Verilog HDL or EDA tool experience is required. Basic knowledge of Linux, scripting and digital circuit design is recommended.Duration and ModeDuration: 4 Weeks (20 Working Days)Mode: OnlineLearning Platform: LMS (24×7 access)Laboratory: NIELIT Calicut Remote Hardware LabCourse and Certification FeeStudents: ₹5,000Faculty: ₹8,000Industry Professionals: ₹10,000CertificationParticipants who successfully complete the programme, including the assigned project and online exit test, will receive a certificate.Course Coordinator:Sreejeesh SGSenior Technical Officer, VLSI LabNIELIT CalicutRegistration:https://www.calicut.nielit.in/OnlineCourseRegistration.aspx?c=OITP_VLSI_B3%2F2026%2F12%2F07

title: International Conference on Sustainable and Novel Solutions in Electronics and Communication Technologies (SNSECT ’ 27)
description: SNSECT’27 advances eco-friendly innovations in electronics and communication via seven tracks: sustainable materials and quantum technologies; energy-efficient VLSI, SoC, and AI hardware; power electronics with…
details_text: SNSECT’27 advances eco-friendly innovations in electronics and communication via seven tracks: sustainable materials and quantum technologies; energy-efficient VLSI, SoC, and AI hardware; power electronics with renewable integration; green optoelectronics, photonics, sensors, and bioelectronics; ecoconscious semiconductor manufacturing and packaging; and sustainable embedded systems with green networks. Focusing on green materials, low-power designs, circular economy, climate resilience, smart cities, and Industry 5.0, it unites researchers, experts, and policymakers for carbon-neutral progress addressing e-waste and energy efficiency.
